value.statement: For every Mbar>=1,a0>=0,0<tau1<=1 and smooth real mean-zero f0,w0 with ||w0||_(H^gamma)<=Mbar and ||f0-w0||_2<=1, let q0=tau1^gamma+||f0-w0||_2 and let Y0,z0,W0,V0 be the corresponding components of Interp_(a0,tau1;f0). Define rho0(t)=-integral_a0^t B_s(Y0,z0)ds-(1/2)integral_a0^t B_s(Y0,Y0)ds-((t-a0)/tau1)W0. On [a0,a0+tau1], V0'=(1/2)B_t(V0,V0)+rho0', rho0'=-B_t(Y0,z0)-(1/2)B_t(Y0,Y0)-W0/tau1, sup||rho0||_2<=C_(gamma,Mbar)*tau1*q0 and ||rho0'||_(L^infinity H^(-pstar))<=C_(gamma,Mbar)*q0.

patches.value: There exists A>=0 depending only on T,gamma,R such that, for every real mean-zero datum uinit in H^gamma with ||uinit||_(H^gamma)<=R, the unique smooth-approximation exact solution uflow of KdV(uflow;uinit) satisfies sup_(0<=t<=T)||uflow(t)||_(H^gamma)<=A. If uinit is smooth, uflow is smooth.

patches.value: There exist C>0,tau_0>0 depending only on T,gamma,R such that, for every smooth real mean-zero datum uinit with H^gamma norm <=R and every positive integer K with h=T/K<=tau_0, its exact solution uflow of KdV(uflow;uinit) and numerical recursion unum^0=uinit, unum^(n+1)=Psi_h(unum^n) satisfy max_(0<=n<=K)||uflow(n*h)-unum^n||_2<=C*h^gamma.
